name: com.pingidentity.pingidsdkv2.PingOneInitProvider
description: When the app process starts, the PingOne MFA (Ping Identity) SDK watches for the app to enter the foreground; it refreshes MFA information and checks whether an authenticator app is configured.
disableEffect: PingOne MFA initialization and authenticator checks will not run, so sign-in verification that relies on this SDK may fail.
